official.name: IIT Kanpur Institute Fellowship (for International Students)

verification.funding_note: Official page states: 'IIT Kanpur offers all foreign degree students a monthly fellowship at par with Indian students.' No rupee figure is published on the scholarship or PG admission pages, so the exact stipend amount cannot be confirmed.
verification.covered_expenses: Monthly fellowship only; the foreign-national application fee is waived. No tuition waiver, accommodation waiver or travel support is stated for the Institute Fellowship.
verification.degree_level: Full-time MS or PhD at IIT Kanpur
eligibility: Foreign national students admitted to a full-time MS or PhD programme at IIT Kanpur
Only students who do not receive any other funding are eligible for the Institute Fellowship
Financial support (Institute Assistantship/Scholarship) is provided to non-sponsored PhD, MTech and MS (By Research), M.Des students
required_docs: Completed application on the IIT Kanpur PG admission portal (application fee of Rs 500 is waived for the 'Foreign National' category)
A separate application form must be filled for each programme or department applied to
verification.deadline_note: Annual cycle. For the July 2026 semester the online portal was open March 19 to April 15, 2026; the last date for foreign-national (Study in India / ICCR / ASEAN etc.) applications is April 15, 2026. Departments may also process PhD applications on a continuous basis.
verification.application_process: Register and submit the online application through the IIT Kanpur PG admissions portal (DoAA PG admission pages). For foreign national applications under Study in India / ICCR / ASEAN categories, contact the Office of International Relations (iitk.ac.in/oir/contact). Admission to PhD, MTech, MS (By Research) and M.Des is for the July 2026 semester.
verification.contact_info: Office of International Relations, Faculty Building Annexe, Level 3, IIT Kanpur, Kanpur, UP 208016, India; +91-512-259-6067; oir@iitk.ac.in
verification.documented_student_count: All eligible foreign degree students (no cap published)
verification.status_note: Verified on IIT Kanpur's Office of International Relations 'Scholarships Schemes' page (iitk.ac.in/oir/scholarship) and PG admission pages (iitk.ac.in/doaa/pgadmission), retrieved 2026-10-10. The scholarship page links foreign nationals to the foreign-national admission process rather than to a separate fellowship application. Foreign nationals are charged IITK's published foreign-national tuition and fees, so budget separately from the fellowship.

applicant_utility.exciting_but_honest_wins: Admission at IIT Kanpur as a foreign student comes with the Institute Fellowship attached: a monthly stipend set at exactly the same level Indian students receive, plus a waived application fee. For a PhD at a top Indian institute, that combination - real money and no scholarship paperwork - is unusual, and Kanpur's research ecosystem (personal computer, office space, and conference travel support for PhD scholars) is the same one domestic scholars use.
applicant_utility.good_fit_if: You hold a strong master's or bachelor's degree and want an MS or PhD at an IIT without needing an external scholarship first. It fits if you can join the July intake, can pay the published foreign-national tuition and hostel charges alongside the stipend, and do not already hold ICCR, ASEAN or other funding - because the Institute Fellowship is only for students with no other funding.
applicant_utility.potential_drawbacks: The official pages never print the stipend figure, so you must plan your finances without a confirmed number, and because the fellowship mirrors the Indian rate it will not stretch far beyond basic living costs. You also carry IITK's foreign-national tuition and fees, and if you win another award the Institute Fellowship disappears. Deadlines are tight: a short March-April window for the July semester.
document_checklist: Online PG admission application per programme/department via the IITK PG portal
No application fee for Foreign National category
For ICCR / ASEAN / Study in India categories, parallel application on those schemes' own portals
Contact the Office of International Relations early about your category
applicant_utility.playbook_for_working_applicants: Confirm your admission category first - Study in India, ICCR, ASEAN or plain foreign national - because each has its own portal and the Institute Fellowship only applies as a fallback when you have no other funding. Apply through the PG admissions portal as soon as the March window opens and complete one form per department so a missed deadline at one does not kill the others. Write to oir@iitk.ac.in about your stipend expectations in writing, then budget as if the stipend only covers living costs, since IITK's foreign-national tuition and hostel fees are charged separately. If you hold an ICCR or ASEAN offer, take it: those bundles (for example, DIA adds a research grant of up to INR 1,70,000) beat the base Institute Fellowship.
